# Admin hardening draft suite (read-only by default)

This directory contains a **draft** (never executed) hardening suite for a
Linux admin host.  Nothing in this directory has been run against any system;
the scripts were only statically checked (`shellcheck`, `bash -n`) and hashed.
No permission or service operation was performed while producing this draft,
and no private key material is embedded anywhere in these files тА?key files
are only referenced by path.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `hardening.sh` | Read-only detection report by default; optional reversible fixes behind `--apply --yes` (root) with backup + manifest |
| `rollback.sh` | Restores the backup manifest; dry-run by default, applies with `--yes` |
| `verify_fresh_login.sh` | Read-only post-login verification (session sanity + detections + baseline drift) |
| `lib/admin_lib.sh` | Shared read-only detection/reporting helpers |
| `REPORT.md` | SHA-256 hashes and `shellcheck` output for this draft |

## Detection coverage (all three scripts)

- **sudo** тА?sudo/wheel group membership, `NOPASSWD`/`!authenticate` rules,
  ownership/mode of `/etc/sudoers` and `/etc/sudoers.d/*`
- **docker** тА?socket presence/mode/owner, docker group membership,
  `daemon.json` exposure on `0.0.0.0`/`[::]`, rootless `/etc/subuid`
- **lxd** тА?lxd unix socket (snap and `/run` paths), lxd group membership
- **cron** тА?cron dir modes, crontab dir/file modes and ownership, at.allow/deny
- **systemd-user** тА?system unit dir modes, non-root/world-writable unit
  files, lingering users, user unit dirs
- **container** тА?`/.dockerenv`, `/run/.containerenv`, `/proc/1/cgroup`
  runtime references, installed runtimes
- **tmux** тА?`/tmp/tmux-UID` dir and socket modes
- **setuid** тА?setuid/setgid binary inventory, world-writable PATH dirs
- **root authorized_keys** тА?presence, mode 600 / root:root, `/root/.ssh`
  mode 700, key-count and comment review (never key content)
- **sockets** тА?world-writable unix sockets under `/run` and `/tmp`,
  TCP listeners on `0.0.0.0`/`[::]`

## Usage (on the target host, when the user explicitly decides to run it)

```sh
bash hardening.sh                       # read-only detection report
bash hardening.sh --apply --yes         # reversible fixes (root), writes backup
bash rollback.sh --backup-dir /root/.hardening-backup        # dry-run plan
bash rollback.sh --yes --backup-dir /root/.hardening-backup  # restore
bash verify_fresh_login.sh              # from a fresh SSH/console login
```

Optional env switches for `--apply`: `HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP=1`,
`HARDENING_REMOVE_LXD_GROUP=1`, `HARDENING_DISABLE_NOPASSWD=1`.

## Draft caveats

- `--apply` fixes are limited to permissions/ownership, socket modes, group
  removals, and optionally commenting out passwordless sudo rules; it never
  strips setuid bits automatically (inventory only) and never removes keys.
- Every touched file is copied into the backup dir first and recorded in
  `manifest.tsv`; rollback restores content, mode and owner.
- The suite targets GNU/Linux (`stat -c`, GNU `find`); it has not been
  executed against any host yet.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# verify_fresh_login.sh -- post-login verification (READ-ONLY).
#
# Intended to be run from a freshly established login session (SSH or
# console) to confirm:
#   * the login session itself works (session metadata sane, sudo usable),
#   * all hardening invariants still hold (same detections as hardening.sh),
#   * no drift versus the baseline captured by hardening.sh --apply.
#
# This script never modifies anything and never requires credentials beyond
# the current session.  It never embeds passwords or private key material.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"

session_checks() {
  printf '== fresh login session ==\n'
  printf '  [INFO] user=%s uid=%s tty=%s\n' \
    "$(id -un 2>/dev/null || printf '?')" \
    "$(id -u 2>/dev/null || printf '?')" \
    "$(tty 2>/dev/null || printf '?')"
  if [ -n "${SSH_CONNECTION:-}" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] ssh session from %s\n' "${SSH_CONNECTION%% *}"
  else
    printf '  [INFO] non-ssh session\n'
  fi
  if have sudo; then
    if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
      printf '  [OK] non-interactive sudo works in this session\n'
    else
      printf '  [INFO] sudo requires a password here (normal after hardening)\n'
    fi
  fi
}

baseline_checks() {
  printf '== baseline drift (backup dir: %s) ==\n' "$BACKUP_DIR"
  if [ ! -f "$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] no baseline found; run hardening.sh --apply --yes first\n'
    return 0
  fi
  if [ -f "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list" ]; then
    local cur
    cur=$(find /bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin -xdev \
      -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -printf '%m %u %g %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort)
    if [ "$cur" = "$(cat "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list")" ]; then
      printf '  [OK] setuid/setgid inventory matches baseline\n'
    else
      printf '  [WARN] setuid/setgid inventory differs from baseline:\n'
      diff "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list" <(printf '%s\n' "$cur") 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    /'
    fi
  fi
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$BACKUP_DIR/root/.ssh/authorized_keys" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$f" "$BACKUP_DIR/root/.ssh/authorized_keys"; then
      printf '  [OK] root authorized_keys unchanged since baseline\n'
    else
      printf '  [WARN] root authorized_keys changed since baseline\n'
    fi
  fi
}

log "=== fresh-login verification (read-only) ==="
session_checks
run_detections
baseline_checks

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# hardening.sh -- admin hardening DRAFT (read-only by default).
#
# Coverage: sudo, docker, lxd, cron, systemd user units, container
# environment, tmux, setuid/setgid binaries, root authorized_keys, sockets.
#
# Safety contract:
#   * Default invocation is a READ-ONLY detection report.
#   * --apply changes nothing unless --yes is also given; --apply requires
#     root.  Without both flags nothing is written.
#   * Every modification is first copied to $BACKUP_DIR and recorded in
#     manifest.tsv; rollback.sh restores from that manifest.
#   * The script contains no passwords and no private key material; key
#     files are only inspected by path.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

APPLY=0
YES=0
BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"
MANIFEST=""
CREATED=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: hardening.sh [--apply] [--yes] [--backup-dir DIR]

  (no flags)          read-only detection report
  --apply             perform reversible hardening fixes (root required)
  --yes               confirm --apply without an interactive prompt
  --backup-dir DIR    override backup location (default: /root/.hardening-backup)

Optional environment switches (only effective together with --apply --yes):
  HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP=1   remove the current user from the docker group
  HARDENING_REMOVE_LXD_GROUP=1      remove the current user from the lxd group
  HARDENING_DISABLE_NOPASSWD=1      comment out NOPASSWD/!authenticate sudo rules
EOF
  exit 0
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --apply) APPLY=1 ;;
    --yes) YES=1 ;;
    --backup-dir)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || fail "--backup-dir requires a value"
      BACKUP_DIR="$2"
      shift
      ;;
    -h|--help) usage ;;
    *) fail "unknown option: $1 (try --help)" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ] && [ "$YES" -ne 1 ]; then
  fail "--apply requires --yes (draft safety: explicit confirmation needed)"
fi
if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ] && [ "$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" != "0" ]; then
  fail "--apply must be run as root"
fi

# --- backup / manifest ------------------------------------------------------
backup_file() {
  local p="$1" bpath mode owner group
  managed_path_ok "$p" || fail "refusing to manage unsafe path: $p"
  [ -e "$p" ] || return 0
  bpath="$BACKUP_DIR${p}"
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$bpath")"
    cp -a "$p" "$bpath"
  else
    bpath="-"   # directories/sockets: record metadata only, no content copy
  fi
  mode=$(stat -c '%a' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  group=$(stat -c '%G' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$bpath" "${mode:-?}" "${owner:-?}" "${group:-?}" >> "$MANIFEST"
  return 0
}

created_file() {
  local p="$1"
  managed_path_ok "$p" || fail "refusing to track unsafe path: $p"
  printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "$CREATED"
}

# --- apply phase ------------------------------------------------------------
fix_sudo() {
  local m f
  if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 750|700|755) ;; *)
      backup_file /etc/sudoers.d
      chmod 750 /etc/sudoers.d
      log "fixed /etc/sudoers.d mode: ${m:-?} -> 750"
      ;;
    esac
  fi
  for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "440" ] && [ "$m" != "400" ]; then
      backup_file "$f"
      chmod 440 "$f"
      log "fixed $f mode: $m -> 440"
    fi
  done
  if [ "${HARDENING_DISABLE_NOPASSWD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      if grep -Es '^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        backup_file "$f"
        sed -i -E '/^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)/ s/^/# HARDENING-DISABLED /' "$f"
        log "commented out NOPASSWD/!authenticate rule(s) in $f"
      fi
    done
    if have visudo; then
      if visudo -c >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "visudo -c: syntax OK"
      else
        warn "visudo -c failed after sudoers edit; restoring from backup"
        "$SCRIPT_DIR/rollback.sh" --yes --backup-dir "$BACKUP_DIR"
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_docker() {
  local sock=/var/run/docker.sock m o
  if [ -S "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) ;; *)
      backup_file "$sock"
      chmod 660 "$sock"
      log "fixed docker socket mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
      ;;
    esac
    o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$o" = "root:root" ]; then
      if chgrp docker "$sock" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "docker socket group -> docker"
      else
        warn "could not chgrp docker socket"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "${HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    if have gpasswd && in_group docker; then
      backup_file /etc/group
      if gpasswd -d "$(id -un)" docker; then
        log "removed $(id -un) from docker group"
      else
        warn "gpasswd -d docker failed"
      fi
    fi
  else
    log "docker group membership not touched (set HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP=1 to remove current user)"
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_lxd() {
  local sock="" c m
  for c in /var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket /run/lxd/unix.socket; do
    [ -S "$c" ] && sock="$c"
  done
  if [ -n "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) ;; *)
      backup_file "$sock"
      chmod 660 "$sock"
      log "fixed lxd socket mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
      ;;
    esac
  fi
  if [ "${HARDENING_REMOVE_LXD_GROUP:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    if have gpasswd && in_group lxd; then
      backup_file /etc/group
      if gpasswd -d "$(id -un)" lxd; then
        log "removed $(id -un) from lxd group"
      else
        warn "gpasswd -d lxd failed"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_cron() {
  local d m f
  for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$d" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755|750|700) ;; *)
      backup_file "$d"
      chmod 755 "$d"
      log "fixed cron dir $d mode: ${m:-?} -> 755"
      ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -d /var/spool/cron/crontabs ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /var/spool/cron/crontabs 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$m" != "700" ]; then
      backup_file /var/spool/cron/crontabs
      chmod 700 /var/spool/cron/crontabs
      log "fixed /var/spool/cron/crontabs mode: ${m:-?} -> 700"
    fi
    for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "600" ]; then
        backup_file "$f"
        chmod 600 "$f"
        log "fixed crontab $f mode: $m -> 600"
      fi
    done
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_systemd_user() {
  local f
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    backup_file "$f"
    chown root:root "$f"
    chmod 644 "$f"
    log "fixed unit ownership/perms: $f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f \( ! -uid 0 -o -perm -002 \) -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

fix_tmux() {
  local dir="/tmp/tmux-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" m
  [ -d "$dir" ] || return 0
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
  case "${m:-?}" in 700) ;; *)
    backup_file "$dir"
    chmod 700 "$dir"
    log "fixed tmux socket dir mode: ${m:-?} -> 700"
    ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

fix_setuid() {
  local out
  out="$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list"
  find /bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin -xdev \
    -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -printf '%m %u %g %p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort > "$out"
  log "setuid/setgid inventory written to $out (draft does not auto-strip bits)"
  return 0
}

fix_root_authorized_keys() {
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys m o
  [ -e "$f" ] || return 0
  backup_file "$f"
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "600" ]; then
    chmod 600 "$f"
    log "fixed authorized_keys mode: $m -> 600"
  fi
  o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$o" ] && [ "$o" != "root:root" ]; then
    chown root:root "$f"
    log "fixed authorized_keys owner: $o -> root:root"
  fi
  m=$(stat -c '%a' /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "700" ]; then
    backup_file /root/.ssh
    chmod 700 /root/.ssh
    log "fixed /root/.ssh mode: $m -> 700"
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_sockets() {
  local s m
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    case "$s" in /run/*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) continue ;; esac
    backup_file "$s"
    chmod 660 "$s"
    log "fixed world-writable socket $s mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
  done < <(find /run -xdev -type s -perm -002 -print 2>/dev/null)
  log "note: world-writable /tmp sockets (e.g. X11) left untouched; review manually"
  return 0
}

apply_all() {
  mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
  MANIFEST="$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv"
  CREATED="$BACKUP_DIR/created.list"
  : > "$MANIFEST"
  : > "$CREATED"
  log "backup dir: $BACKUP_DIR"
  fix_sudo
  fix_docker
  fix_lxd
  fix_cron
  fix_systemd_user
  fix_tmux
  fix_setuid
  fix_root_authorized_keys
  fix_sockets
  log "apply phase complete; manifest: $MANIFEST"
  log "rollback with: $SCRIPT_DIR/rollback.sh --yes --backup-dir '$BACKUP_DIR'"
}

# --- main -------------------------------------------------------------------
log "=== hardening draft: read-only detection phase ==="
run_detections
if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  log "=== apply phase (reversible) ==="
  apply_all
fi
log "done"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# admin_lib.sh -- shared read-only detection/reporting helpers for the
# hardening draft suite (hardening.sh / rollback.sh / verify_fresh_login.sh).
#
# Contract:
#   * Sourcing this file changes no system state and touches no credentials.
#   * Every detect_* function is read-only and prints a small report block.
#   * Writing operations live in the calling scripts and are always gated
#     behind explicit --apply --yes flags.
#   * This suite never embeds passwords or private key material; key files
#     are only inspected by path.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2317  # detect_*/fix_* helpers are invoked by callers

# --- logging ---------------------------------------------------------------
log()  { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '[WARN] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
fail() { printf '[ERROR] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

in_group() {
  local g="$1"
  id -nG 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx "$g"
}

# Only paths below these roots may ever be managed, and symlinks are refused.
managed_path_ok() {
  local p="$1"
  case "$p" in
    /etc/*|/root/*|/var/run/*|/run/*|/tmp/*) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  [ -L "$p" ] && return 1
  return 0
}

# --- detection: sudo -------------------------------------------------------
detect_sudo() {
  printf '== sudo ==\n'
  if ! have sudo; then
    printf '  [INFO] sudo binary not installed\n'
    return 0
  fi
  if in_group sudo || in_group wheel; then
    printf '  [WARN] current user is a member of the sudo/wheel group\n'
  fi
  local f own m
  for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
    [ -r "$f" ] || continue
    if grep -Es '^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf '  [WARN] passwordless/!authenticate sudo rule in %s\n' "$f"
    fi
    own=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$own" ] && [ "$own" != "root:root" ]; then
      printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:root)\n' "$f" "$own"
    fi
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "440" ] && [ "$m" != "400" ]; then
      printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s (common: 440)\n' "$f" "$m"
    fi
  done
  if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 750|700|755) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] /etc/sudoers.d mode=%s (expected 750/700)\n' "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: docker -----------------------------------------------------
detect_docker() {
  printf '== docker / container runtime ==\n'
  local sock=/var/run/docker.sock m o
  if [ -S "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s owner=%s\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}" "${o:-?}"
    case "${m:-?}" in
      660|600) ;;
      *) printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (common: 660 root:docker)\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}" ;;
    esac
    if [ -n "$o" ] && [ "$o" != "root:docker" ] && [ "$o" != "root:root" ]; then
      printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:docker)\n' "$sock" "$o"
    fi
  else
    printf '  [INFO] no docker socket at %s\n' "$sock"
  fi
  if have docker; then
    if in_group docker; then
      printf '  [WARN] current user is in the docker group (root-equivalent)\n'
    fi
    if [ -r /etc/docker/daemon.json ]; then
      if grep -qE 'tcp://(0\.0\.0\.0|\[::\])' /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  [WARN] docker daemon configured to listen on 0.0.0.0/[::]\n'
      fi
      if grep -q '"hosts"' /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  [INFO] custom docker daemon hosts configured\n'
      fi
    fi
  fi
  [ -f /etc/subuid ] && printf '  [INFO] rootless-docker style /etc/subuid present\n'
  return 0
}

# --- detection: lxd --------------------------------------------------------
detect_lxd() {
  printf '== lxd ==\n'
  local sock="" c m
  for c in /var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket /run/lxd/unix.socket; do
    [ -S "$c" ] && sock="$c"
  done
  if [ -n "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [WARN] lxd socket %s mode=%s (lxd group is root-equivalent)\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}"
  else
    printf '  [INFO] no lxd unix socket found\n'
  fi
  if have lxc || have lxd; then
    if in_group lxd; then
      printf '  [WARN] current user is in the lxd group (root-equivalent)\n'
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: cron -------------------------------------------------------
detect_cron() {
  printf '== cron ==\n'
  local d m f own
  for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$d" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755|750|700) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] cron dir %s mode=%s (no world write)\n' "$d" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  done
  if [ -d /var/spool/cron/crontabs ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /var/spool/cron/crontabs 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] /var/spool/cron/crontabs mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "${m:-?}"
    for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      own=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      case "${m:-?}" in 600) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] crontab %s mode=%s (expected 600)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
      case "$own" in
        *:crontab|root:root) ;;
        *) printf '  [WARN] crontab %s owner=%s (expected <user>:crontab)\n' "$f" "${own:-?}" ;;
      esac
    done
  fi
  if [ -f /etc/at.deny ] && [ ! -f /etc/at.allow ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] /etc/at.deny present without /etc/at.allow\n'
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: systemd user units / lingering -----------------------------
detect_systemd_user() {
  printf '== systemd user units / lingering ==\n'
  if ! have systemctl; then
    printf '  [INFO] systemd not present\n'
    return 0
  fi
  local u m f
  for u in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system; do
    [ -d "$u" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$u" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (expected 755)\n' "$u" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  done
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [WARN] unit file not owned by root: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f ! -uid 0 -print 2>/dev/null)
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [WARN] world-writable unit file: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm -002 -print 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -d /var/lib/systemd/linger ]; then
    local u2
    for u2 in /var/lib/systemd/linger/*; do
      [ -e "$u2" ] || continue
      printf '  [INFO] lingering systemd user: %s\n' "${u2##*/}"
    done
  fi
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [INFO] systemd user unit: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /root/.config/systemd/user /home/*/.config/systemd/user -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: container environment --------------------------------------
detect_container() {
  printf '== container environment ==\n'
  local hint=""
  [ -f /.dockerenv ] && hint="${hint}docker "
  [ -f /run/.containerenv ] && hint="${hint}podman/containerd "
  if [ -n "$hint" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] container marker(s) found: %s\n' "$hint"
  fi
  if [ -r /proc/1/cgroup ] && grep -qE 'docker|lxc|kubepods|containerd' /proc/1/cgroup 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '  [INFO] /proc/1/cgroup references a container runtime\n'
  fi
  local r
  for r in docker podman containerd nerdctl; do
    have "$r" && printf '  [INFO] container runtime installed: %s\n' "$r"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- detection: tmux -------------------------------------------------------
detect_tmux() {
  printf '== tmux ==\n'
  if ! have tmux; then
    printf '  [INFO] tmux not installed\n'
    return 0
  fi
  local dir m s
  dir="/tmp/tmux-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] tmux socket dir %s mode=%s\n' "$dir" "${m:-?}"
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] tmux socket dir %s mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "$dir" "${m:-?}"
  fi
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] tmux socket %s mode=%s\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] tmux socket %s mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find /tmp -maxdepth 2 -type s -path '/tmp/tmux-*' -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: setuid/setgid ----------------------------------------------
detect_setuid() {
  printf '== setuid/setgid binaries ==\n'
  local roots=(/bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin)
  local f m
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] setuid/setgid: %s (%s)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find "${roots[@]}" -xdev -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -print 2>/dev/null)
  local path_copy="$PATH" dirs dir
  IFS=':' read -r -a dirs <<< "$path_copy"
  for dir in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    [ -n "$dir" ] || dir="."
    [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in
      1777|0777) printf '  [WARN] world-writable directory in PATH: %s\n' "$dir" ;;
    esac
  done
  return 0
}

# --- detection: root authorized_keys ---------------------------------------
detect_root_authorized_keys() {
  printf '== root authorized_keys ==\n'
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys m o n x c
  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    printf '  [OK] no %s\n' "$f"
    return 0
  fi
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s owner=%s\n' "$f" "${m:-?}" "${o:-?}"
  [ "$m" = "600" ] || printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (expected 600)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}"
  [ "$o" = "root:root" ] || printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:root)\n' "$f" "${o:-?}"
  m=$(stat -c '%a' /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] /root/.ssh mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "${m:-?}"
  n=$(grep -vcE '^\s*(#|$)' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf '  [INFO] %s non-comment key line(s)\n' "${n:-0}"
  if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    while IFS= read -r c; do
      printf '  [WARN] key with suspicious comment in %s: %s\n' "$f" "$c"
    done < <(grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $3}' | grep -Ei 'backup|emergency|unknown|temp|draft' || true)
  fi
  while IFS= read -r x; do
    printf '  [WARN] non-root-owned file in /root/.ssh: %s\n' "$x"
  done < <(find /root/.ssh -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -uid 0 -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: sockets ----------------------------------------------------
detect_sockets() {
  printf '== sockets ==\n'
  local s m
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [WARN] world-writable unix socket: %s (%s)\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find /run /tmp -xdev -type s -perm -002 -print 2>/dev/null)
  if have ss; then
    ss -lnt 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || $4 ~ /(0\.0\.0\.0|\[::\]):/ {print "  [INFO] listening: " $0}'
  else
    printf '  [INFO] ss not available; TCP listen inventory skipped\n'
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- runner ----------------------------------------------------------------
run_detections() {
  local out warns
  out=$(detect_sudo; detect_docker; detect_lxd; detect_cron; detect_systemd_user; detect_container; detect_tmux; detect_setuid; detect_root_authorized_keys; detect_sockets)
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
  warns=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '\[WARN\]' || true)
  printf 'summary: %s warning(s)\n' "${warns:-0}"
  return 0
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rollback.sh -- restore state changed by hardening.sh --apply.
#
# Default is a read-only dry run that prints the restore plan from the
# manifest.  With --yes (and root), it restores file contents, modes and
# ownership, and removes files listed in created.list.
#
# Every path is validated by managed_path_ok() (fixed roots, no symlinks)
# before it is touched.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"
YES=0

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: rollback.sh [--yes] [--backup-dir DIR]

  (no flags)       dry run: print the restore plan, change nothing
  --yes            apply the restore (root required)
  --backup-dir DIR backup directory written by hardening.sh --apply
EOF
  exit 0
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --yes) YES=1 ;;
    --backup-dir)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || fail "--backup-dir requires a value"
      BACKUP_DIR="$2"
      shift
      ;;
    -h|--help) usage ;;
    *) fail "unknown option: $1 (try --help)" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

[ -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ] || fail "backup dir not found: $BACKUP_DIR"

restore_manifest() {
  local manifest="$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" p bpath mode owner group
  [ -f "$manifest" ] || fail "no manifest at $manifest"
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r p bpath mode owner group; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    managed_path_ok "$p" || { warn "skipping unsafe path in manifest: $p"; continue; }
    if [ "$bpath" != "-" ] && [ -f "$bpath" ]; then
      if cp -a "$bpath" "$p"; then
        log "restored $p from backup"
      fi
    fi
    if [ -n "$mode" ] && [ "$mode" != "?" ]; then
      if chmod "$mode" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "chmod $p -> $mode"
      else
        warn "chmod failed: $p"
      fi
    fi
    if [ -n "$owner" ] && [ -n "$group" ] && [ "$owner" != "?" ] && [ "$group" != "?" ]; then
      if chown "$owner:$group" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "chown $p -> $owner:$group"
      else
        warn "chown failed: $p"
      fi
    fi
  done < "$manifest"
  if [ -f "$BACKUP_DIR/created.list" ]; then
    local p2
    while IFS= read -r p2; do
      [ -n "$p2" ] || continue
      managed_path_ok "$p2" || { warn "skipping unsafe path in created.list: $p2"; continue; }
      rm -f "$p2" && log "removed created file: $p2"
    done < "$BACKUP_DIR/created.list"
  fi
  log "rollback complete; manifest kept at $manifest"
}

if [ "$YES" -ne 1 ]; then
  log "dry run: would restore the following (pass --yes to apply):"
  cat "$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 0
fi

[ "$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" = "0" ] || fail "rollback --yes must be run as root"
restore_manifest

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import socket
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

if __package__ in {None, ""}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
    from p5_infra.research_db import (  # type: ignore
        ALPHA_DISCOVERY_AUTHORITY, STATISTICAL_TRIAL_AUTHORITY, WORKLOAD,
        FailClosed, ResearchDB, ResearchError, canonical_json, runtime_info,
    )
else:
    from .research_db import (
        ALPHA_DISCOVERY_AUTHORITY, STATISTICAL_TRIAL_AUTHORITY, WORKLOAD,
        FailClosed, ResearchDB, ResearchError, canonical_json, runtime_info,
    )


DEFAULT_ROOT = "/data/k3/research"


def read_json(value: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value == "-":
        data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    elif value.startswith("@"):
        data = json.loads(Path(value[1:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    else:
        data = json.loads(value)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise FailClosed("JSON input must be an object")
    return data


def envelope(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "tool": "researchctl",
        "contract_version": 1,
        "scope": "INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY",
        "authority": {
            "workload": WORKLOAD,
            "statistical_trial_authority": STATISTICAL_TRIAL_AUTHORITY,
            "alpha_discovery_authority": ALPHA_DISCOVERY_AUTHORITY,
        },
        "result": result,
    }


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    root = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="K3 Research Memory single write gateway")
    root.add_argument("--root", default=os.environ.get("K3_RESEARCH_ROOT", DEFAULT_ROOT))
    root.add_argument("--socket", default=os.environ.get("RESEARCHCTL_SOCKET", "/run/researchctl/control.sock"))
    root.add_argument("--direct", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    sub = root.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("runtime-info")
    sub.add_parser("init")
    sub.add_parser("verify")
    sub.add_parser("rebuild-check")

    record = sub.add_parser("record")
    record.add_argument("--entity-type", required=True)
    record.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    record.add_argument("--actor-owner-id", required=True)
    record.add_argument("--payload", required=True, help="JSON, '-' for stdin, or '@path'")

    pit = sub.add_parser("as-of")
    pit.add_argument("--research-campaign-id", required=True)
    pit.add_argument("--as-of", required=True)
    pit.add_argument("--entity-type")

    export = sub.add_parser("export-ledger")
    export.add_argument("--output", required=True)

    backup = sub.add_parser("backup-verify")
    backup.add_argument("--backup", required=True)
    backup.add_argument("--restore", required=True)

    migrate = sub.add_parser("migrate")
    migrate.add_argument("--migration-id", required=True)
    migrate.add_argument("--from-version", type=int, required=True)
    migrate.add_argument("--to-version", type=int, required=True)
    migrate.add_argument("--script", required=True)
    migrate.add_argument("--evidence-dir", required=True)
    propose = sub.add_parser("authority-propose")
    propose.add_argument("--payload", required=True)
    trans = sub.add_parser("authority-transition")
    trans.add_argument("--proposal-id", required=True)
    trans.add_argument("--target", required=True, choices=("PRECONDITIONS_PASS","HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED","APPLIED"))
    trans.add_argument("--observed-binding-sha256")
    dreg = sub.add_parser("delegation-register")
    dreg.add_argument("--payload", required=True)
    dred = sub.add_parser("delegation-redeem")
    dred.add_argument("--delegation-id", required=True)
    dred.add_argument("--proposal", required=True)
    drev = sub.add_parser("delegation-revoke")
    drev.add_argument("--delegation-id", required=True)
    areg = sub.add_parser("amendment-register")
    areg.add_argument("--delegation-id", required=True)
    areg.add_argument("--amendment-id", required=True, choices=("C","A","B"))
    areg.add_argument("--amendment-sha256", required=True)
    return root


def daemon_request(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request = {key: value for key, value in vars(args).items() if key not in {"root", "socket", "direct"}}
    if args.command in {"record", "authority-propose", "delegation-register"}:
        request["payload"] = read_json(args.payload)
    if args.command == "delegation-redeem":
        request["proposal"] = read_json(args.proposal)
    encoded = (json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as client:
        client.settimeout(120)
        client.connect(args.socket)
        client.sendall(encoded)
        stream = client.makefile("rb")
        raw = stream.readline(1024 * 1024 + 1)
    response = json.loads(raw)
    if not response.get("ok"):
        raise FailClosed(f"{response.get('error_code')}: {response.get('error')}")
    result = response["result"]
    result["writer_gateway"] = "researchctld"
    result["authenticated_peer_uid"] = response.get("peer_uid")
    return result


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        use_daemon = not args.direct and args.root == DEFAULT_ROOT and Path(args.socket).is_socket()
        if use_daemon:
            result = daemon_request(args)
        elif args.command == "runtime-info":
            result = runtime_info()
        else:
            db = ResearchDB(args.root)
            if args.command == "init":
                result = db.initialize()
            elif args.command == "verify":
                result = db.verify()
            elif args.command == "rebuild-check":
                result = db.rebuild_check()
            elif args.command == "record":
                result = db.record(args.entity_type, read_json(args.payload), args.operation_id, args.actor_owner_id)
            elif args.command == "as-of":
                result = db.pit(args.research_campaign_id, args.as_of, args.entity_type)
            elif args.command == "export-ledger":
                result = db.export_ledger(args.output)
            elif args.command == "backup-verify":
                result = db.backup_verify(args.backup, args.restore)
            elif args.command == "migrate":
                result = db.migrate(args.migration_id, args.from_version, args.to_version, args.script, args.evidence_dir)
            else:
                raise AssertionError(args.command)
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(envelope(result), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
        return 0 if result.get("status", "PASS") == "PASS" or result.get("status") in {"CREATED", "DEDUPLICATED"} else 2
    except (ResearchError, OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        code = getattr(exc, "code", exc.__class__.__name__.upper())
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(envelope({"status": "FAIL_CLOSED", "error_code": code, "error": str(exc)}), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
        return 2
    except BaseException as exc:
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(envelope({"status": "FAIL_CLOSED", "error_code": "INTERNAL_ERROR", "error": f"{exc.__class__.__name__}: {exc}"}), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
        return 70


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
echo '===== IDENTITY ====='
whoami
id
hostname
uname -a
echo '===== GROUPS (id -nG) ====='
id -nG
echo '===== GROUP LOOKUPS ====='
for g in sudo docker research-client research-writer wheel adm systemd-journal systemd-coredump; do
  if getent group "$g" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$g => $(getent group "$g")"; else echo "$g => ABSENT"; fi
done
echo '===== SUDO -n -l ====='
sudo -n -l 2>&1 || true
echo '===== SUDOERS FILE PERMS ====='
ls -l /etc/sudoers 2>&1 || true
ls -ld /etc/sudoers.d 2>&1 || true
ls -l /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>&1 | head -20 || true
echo '===== PROCESS CAPABILITIES ====='
grep -E '^(CapInh|CapPrm|CapEff|CapBnd):' /proc/self/status 2>&1 || true
if command -v capsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then capsh --print 2>&1 | head -10; fi
echo '===== DOCKER SOCKET ====='
for s in /var/run/docker.sock /run/docker.sock; do
  ls -l "$s" 2>&1 || true
  stat -c '%A %a %U %G %n' "$s" 2>&1 || true
done
echo '===== DOCKER CLI (read-only) ====='
docker version --format 'client={{.Client.Version}} server={{.Server.Version}}' 2>&1 | head -5 || true
docker context ls 2>&1 | head -5 || true
echo '===== RESEARCHCTL ====='
command -v researchctl 2>&1 || true
ls -l /usr/local/bin/researchctl* 2>&1 || true
stat -c '%A %a %U %G %n' /usr/local/bin/researchctl 2>&1 || true
getcap /usr/local/bin/researchctl 2>&1 || true
ls -ld /etc/research* /usr/local/etc/research* /var/lib/research* 2>&1 || true
echo '===== SYSTEMCTL CONTROL PROBES (read-only) ====='
systemctl --version 2>&1 | head -1 || true
systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
systemctl status ssh --no-pager 2>&1 | head -6 || true
systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager 2>&1 | head -3 || true
loginctl show-user "$USER" -p Linger -p KillUserProcesses 2>&1 || true
echo '===== POLKIT RULES ====='
ls -ld /etc/polkit-1/rules.d /usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d 2>&1 || true
grep -RniE 'systemd1|manage-units|org\.freedesktop\.systemd' /etc/polkit-1/rules.d /usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d /etc/polkit-1/localauthority.conf.d 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true
echo '===== ROOT-EQUIVALENT HINTS: WRITABLE DIRS ====='
for p in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /etc/cron.d /etc/sudoers.d /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin /opt /data/k3; do
  if test -w "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WRITABLE: $p"; else echo "not writable: $p"; fi
done
ls -ld /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /etc/cron.d /etc/sudoers.d /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin /opt 2>&1 || true
echo '===== PATH WRITABLE ENTRIES ====='
for d in ${PATH//:/ }; do
  if test -w "$d" 2>/dev/null; then echo "PATH-WRITABLE: $d"; fi
done
echo '===== SETUID BINARIES (common paths, maxdepth 1) ====='
find /usr/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin -maxdepth 1 -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true
echo '===== SENSITIVE FILES ====='
ls -l /etc/shadow /etc/gshadow /etc/passwd 2>&1 || true
if test -r /etc/shadow; then echo '/etc/shadow READABLE=YES'; else echo '/etc/shadow READABLE=NO'; fi
ls -ld "$HOME" 2>&1 || true
echo '===== DONE ====='
